English

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From inter- +‎ Latin lingua (“language”).[1]

Noun

[edit]

interlingua (plural interlinguas)

  1. an interlanguage

References

[edit]
  1. ^ “Interlingua, n.”, in OED Online ⁠, Oxford: Oxford University Press, launched 2000.
